educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
In Japanese Communication 3, students aim for further development of basic grammar
 through communication tasks. Students will focus on developing skills of communic
ation in modern Japanese reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
advice:
Students will learn to conduct daily conversations in Japanese and deal with basic daily situations by focusing
on fluency of basic grammar. Social and cultural manners and gestures necessary for appropriate communication wi
th native speakers will also be introduced and reinforced with practical communication activities.
　
This course has a Moodle course site. All important information about course related matters will be posted on t
his site. It is students' responsibility to check the site regularly.
